verdict.rationale: GlitchTip ships a built-in MCP server that lets AI tools browse issues, inspect stack traces/event data, and resolve issues, effectively enabling natural-language operation via connected AI assistants (glitchtip-docs-9, glitchtip-docs-10, glitchtip-probe-4). However, this is only vendor documentation with no independent or hands-on confirmation that the natural-language workflow works as described. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of the MCP server's NL command capabilities, and concrete examples of supported commands/actions beyond 'browse/inspect/resolve'.
